svg.content: <mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" type="device"><diagram id="14-semantic-hierarchy" name="14 · Semantic evidence entities"><mxGraphModel grid="0" gridSize="10" page="0" pageWidth="1469.0" pageHeight="1586.9840000000002" shadow="0" adaptiveColors="auto" scopeDescription="Implemented entities and conceptual associations; database enforcement is stated in the constraint note." schemaConstraints="UML entity model: solid lines are associations; multiplicities describe the named roles, not database integrity. Attributes use [0..1] for optional values and [0..*] for lists. {PK}/{UQ} are schema-key constraints. Enforced relations and scalar-ID mappings are listed below; cross-service IDs are not foreign keys. {xor}: each chunk has either a section parent or a document parent; both links require the same indexAttemptId. Chunk has one parent selected by strategy: section OR document. The two optional parent links are alternatives, not simultaneous parents. Semantic tables use rowId PK and UNIQUE(id,indexAttemptId). Historical candidates can exist; retrieval serves accepted active rows. Migrations declare partial uniqueness for active rows: at most one active ReelDocument per Reel, and one active section/chunk/scene per stable id. Live migration application is not probed. reel: reelId: cross-service reference (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); document: parentId = reelDocumentId, same attempt (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); document: parentId = reelDocumentId, same attempt (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); section parent: long-form chunk: parentId = sectionId (scalar-ID association; no declared FK); document parent: short/document chunk: parentId = reelDocumentId (scalar-ID association; no declared FK)"><root><mxCell id="0" style="fontFamily=Arial;" value="" /><mxCell id="1" parent="0"
